'''Spore disinfectants''' were a type of [[disinfectant spray]] in use by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The sprays were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces during the [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] fought there. The spray killed spores which attacked shuttles flying in the planets harsh atmosphere and caused large amounts of damage to the vessels as well as potentially giving any occupants [[Spore Sickness]]. The chemicals used in the spray however had to be changed about once a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] due to the adaptogenic nature which allowed them to develop immunity to the spray quickly. Two [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] sprayed down the shuttle used to transport the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] to [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] upon her arrival at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]].

==Behind the scenes==
Spore disinfectant first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].
